findings.reason: implemented as written, a run that asserted code but whose tree was unreadable at promotion records no revision and is reported landed, so its waiter launches on work that never reached the primary branch; the plan should say the key is absent when promotion could not resolve a revision (shadow or unreadable tree) and keep the ancestry test for every run whose commits are known.
findings.text: s8 says "Promotion leaves that key absent when the run asserted no code, a review for instance, so such a run has landed once its row exists", but the cited code does the opposite for that example: `_promoted_revision` falls back to the run tree's `HEAD` when the manifest cites no commits (`reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:307-309`), the guard at `reckon/crew/promotion.py:1479` only drops the key when that resolution returns empty, and the reckon ledger agrees — all 4240 promoted review rows carry `promoted_revision` (0 of 5968 rows lack it, and 4378 commit-free rows carry one, equal to their `base_sha`). The key is absent only when `_record_tree` finds no readable worktree or repo (`reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:957-973`) or the promotion is a shadow (`reckon/crew/promotion.py:1313`), so s8's "row exists ⇒ landed" branch fires on an unresolvable revision, not on a code-less run

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every symbol and module s8 cites resolves at ad3cc0e5e: `run_path` (`reckon/ledger.py:890`), `RUN_DELIVERED_STATUSES` and `_readiness_rows` (`reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1023,1056`), `_readiness_by_slug` (`reckon/crew/plan_review.py:3094`), `parse_plan_ref` (`reckon/_schema.py:276`), `MANIFEST_STATUSES`/`TERMINAL_MANIFEST_STATUSES` (`reckon/crew/reports.py:126,138`), and `reckon/crew/node.py`, `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the done-when carries negative controls: the negative arm declares B's §2 done before queuing and expects the request straight into `queued`, and separate arms close an upstream `blocked` and `failed` and require the waiter never launches.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — s8 names no scratchpad or node-local path; its write paths are repository modules plus a new test file, and its gate logs fall under the run directory per the plan's convention.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol or comment that s8 asks for.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — s8 now defines the absence of `promoted_revision` as the no-code case ("a review for instance"), but the cited code records a revision for that case and drops the key only when it cannot resolve one.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one deliverable, DAG-aware waits across plans and projects; the readiness-assembly factoring and the landed definition are the mechanism of that single goal, not a second one.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s8's declared depends-on (s2) and the inbound edges from s9 and s15 are present in `plan-section-depends-on`, and the cross-project ref form it introduces resolves through each mounted project's own readiness.
